evidence.why: Identifies the caller's target, scalar output and tuning arguments.
Proves pointer types, threshold branches and x/y-only velocity writes.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's two-vector description and preserves the helper's exceptional near-target branch and scalar-output semantics.
facts.value: Updates Master Hand's SweepLoop movement by passing the stored Vec3 target xC, scalar output x18, threshold x2C and proportional factor x28 to ftBossLib_8015BE40. The helper computes the three-dimensional target-position difference. Below the threshold it sets x18 to zero and uses the unscaled difference; otherwise it stores the distance and normalizes/scales the difference by distance times x28. Both paths replace self_vel.x and self_vel.y only; self_vel.z is not assigned.
